root_cause.text: The q6apm-lpass-dai `prepare` path for playback reopened the ASoC graph every time it was called because it lacked a guard against an already-open `dai_data->graph[dai->id]`, allowing repeated prepare calls to leak graph resources.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `q6apm_lpass_dai_prepare()` from unconditionally calling `q6apm_graph_open()` on `SNDRV_PCM_STREAM_PLAYBACK` to doing so only when `dai_data->graph[dai->id] == NULL`, and the commit message states that “prepare can be called multiple times” causing “multiple graph opens for playback path” and “memory leaks.”

agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch changes `q6apm_lpass_dai_prepare()` from unconditionally calling `q6apm_graph_open()` on `SNDRV_PCM_STREAM_PLAYBACK` to doing so only when `dai_data->graph[dai->id] == NULL`, and the commit message states that “prepare can be called multiple times” causing “multiple graph opens for playback path” and “memory leaks.”

intent_record.intent_summary: Prevent reopening an existing playback graph during DAI প্রস্তুparation by only opening it when no graph is already present.
intent_record.what: The playback-branch condition in q6apm_lpass_dai_prepare() was changed from checking only whether the substream is playback to checking both playback and that dai_data->graph[dai->id] is NULL before opening a graph.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the code now avoids reopening an already existing playback graph for the same DAI ID, while still opening it when no graph has been created yet. This prevents duplicate graph setup and limits the open call to the initial preparation path.

grouping_result.intent: Prevent reopening an existing playback graph during DAI প্রস্তুparation by only opening it when no graph is already present.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly matches the root cause: it adds a guard to avoid reopening an already-open playback graph during prepare, preventing repeated prepare calls from leaking graph resources.

candidates.rationale: This unconditional open in the playback prepare path is the direct cause of the bug: without checking whether dai_data->graph[dai->id] is already set, repeated prepare calls reopen the graph and can leak resources.

vuln_statements.explanation: This unconditional graph-open call in the playback prepare path reopens the ASoC graph every time prepare runs, because it is not guarded by a check for an already-open dai_data->graph[dai->id]. That repeated reopening is the resource leak root cause.
